title: Russia Turns Up The Volume
summary:
Crude oil exports to China are increasing
Russian crude oil production and exports have been in the news lately. It is being reported that Russia is shipping more crude to China and less to Europe. This shift in target market seems logical since the Chinese market is bigger and growing faster.
